patterns_detected.pattern: Directional bias works — on the right side
patterns_detected.evidence: Both wins = SELL. 3 losses = 2 BUY + 1 gap. When bot sold EURUSD, it won convincingly (avg +$1,974). When it bought, it lost (avg -$996).
patterns_detected.recommendation: Add a session-level trend filter. If the last N hours showed a clear direction, bias entries to match. Specifically: if the last closed trade was a win in direction X, do NOT open a trade in the opposite direction for at least 60 minutes.

patterns_detected.evidence: Trade 3 closed SELL TP at 01:01 UTC. Trade 4 opened BUY at 01:04 UTC. 3 minutes apart. The winning SELL was held 5.5 hours, and within 3 minutes of closing, the bot flipped to BUY.
patterns_detected.recommendation: Implement a cooldown timer after any TP hit. No trade in the opposite direction within 60-90 minutes. The bot needs time for price to establish a new signal, not enter immediately on the reversal.

patterns_detected.evidence: Trade 2 was entered Friday, held through weekend, gap-opened 18 pips below entry (6 pips past SL). Added ~$476 extra loss.
patterns_detected.recommendation: Consider restricting trades on Friday after 12:00 UTC (London close). Weekend gap risk is systemic and cannot be solved at SL level — only by not being in a position.

patterns_detected.pattern: Winners held long — losers cut short
patterns_detected.evidence: Wins: 5h17m and 5h30m. Losses: 12m and 2h09m. The bot is not cutting winners prematurely — it lets them run. The issue is entering bad trades, not exiting good ones.
patterns_detected.recommendation: No change needed to exit logic. TP is working correctly. Focus improvement on ENTRY quality, not exit.

improvement_recommendations.detail: If EURUSD has moved 15+ pips in one direction in the last 2 hours (measured from VWAP), only enter trades aligned with that direction. This prevents buying into a falling market.
improvement_recommendations.testable: Backtest on July 13: would this have blocked Trade 4 and Trade 5? Likely yes (EURUSD fell from 1.14368 to 1.14069 = 30 pips down in 6 hours).
improvement_recommendations.risk: Could filter out valid reversal trades. Start with directional bias as a SOFT filter (reduce volume 50% on counter-trend) rather than HARD block.

improvement_recommendations.change: Cooldown timer after any TP/SL hit
improvement_recommendations.detail: No new trade in ANY direction for 30 minutes after a trade closes (win or loss). This prevents whip-lash entries.
improvement_recommendations.testable: Would have blocked Trade 4 (entered 3 min after Trade 3 TP). Without Trade 4, Trade 5 might also have been blocked due to max-daily-trade limit.
improvement_recommendations.risk: Could miss a valid reversal signal in fast markets. 30 min is conservative; could adjust to 15 min.

improvement_recommendations.detail: Do NOT open new trades on Friday after 12:00 UTC. If a trade is open Friday morning, let it run (SL/TP are set). But no NEW entries after the London session closes.
improvement_recommendations.testable: Would not have affected any win — the two wins were Monday/Tuesday.
improvement_recommendations.risk: Misses any Friday-only patterns. Low risk — Friday afternoon is typically thin and unpredictable.

improvement_recommendations.detail: TP is working (2/2 wins hit TP exactly). SL is working (all losses capped). Do not change R:R parameters. The problem is entering bad trades, not exiting them.
improvement_recommendations.testable: Maintain 1:2 RR. Monitor next 10 trades. If win rate stays below 40%, re-evaluate entry criteria (deviation threshold or candle confirmation).
